# solstone

> solstone is a personal memory platform. the solstone app takes in what you share with it, and all of it goes into your journal. your journal is always private, only yours. open source, made by sol pbc. the journal lives on linux, and on macos on apple silicon. the journal does not live on windows. a windows owner needs a mac or linux machine where the journal lives. the journal ships as one self-contained tree. it needs no interpreter and no package manager of its own. the two commands are `solstone` and `journal`. one tree covers the journal on this machine and talking to a journal that already lives elsewhere. the solstone app on each device is a separate install. the tree is not published yet. its release channel is `updates.solstone.app`, and `install.sh` is already live at https://solstone.app/install.sh. until the first release lands, start from a local build or a copy someone handed you and follow [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/solpbc/solstone-journal/blob/main/INSTALL.md). once it is published: `curl -fsSL https://solstone.app/install.sh | sh` then `journal setup`. on macos, install the solstone app from the signed bundle at https://solstone.app/download.

your journal holds transcripts, people and projects, meetings, a knowledge graph, and daily insights. it is a folder of dated directories. your journal has full-text search, transcript browsing, and calendar views.

the project is maintained by sol pbc (https://solpbc.org), a colorado public benefit corporation. the data covenants in its articles of incorporation can't be amended without the founder's personal signature, and after the founder the language can only get stronger, never weaker. any acquisition is conditional: the successor must be legally bound to preserve a substantially equivalent benefit purpose and assume covenants no less protective than article 8. the code is open source.

## Docs

- [Get started](https://github.com/solpbc/solstone-journal/blob/main/INSTALL.md): install guide for a coding agent and human working together
- [README](https://github.com/solpbc/solstone-journal/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, architecture, quick start, and CLI reference
- [Install the solstone app on your devices](https://solstone.app/download): the solstone app for macos, linux, and windows. tmux is a separate install. pick your platform and copy the prompt for your agent. a windows owner needs a mac or linux machine where the journal lives.
- [Journal structure](https://github.com/solpbc/solstone-journal/blob/main/docs/JOURNAL.md): Data model and daily directory layout
- [AI providers](https://github.com/solpbc/solstone-journal/blob/main/docs/PROVIDERS.md): provider setup
- [Web interface](https://github.com/solpbc/solstone-journal/blob/main/docs/CONVEY.md): the web UI for browsing the journal
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/solpbc/solstone-journal/blob/main/docs/DOCTOR.md): Diagnostics and common issues
